name: Lusha
description: Let agents look up business contacts and companies in Lusha: job title, work email and phone, company size, industry and recent changes. For account research, call lists and matching event delegates to sponsors.
identity: A Lusha API key. Every lookup that reveals an email or phone number spends your company's Lusha credits, so give the key its own credit limit.

setup.title: Create an API key with a credit limit
setup.body: You need a Lusha admin or manager for this, so the key can carry a credit limit of its own. The key acts as the person who made it and spends from your company's shared credits. Lusha shows the key on the API page; copy it for the form below.
click: In Lusha, open API & connectors in the left sidebar, then the Manage API Keys tab.
Create a key for agents and set its credit limit to what agents may spend.

capabilities.label: Look up contacts
capabilities.description: Find one person by email, LinkedIn address, Lusha id, or name and company: job title, seniority, department, start date and previous job, location, work email and phone.
capabilities.note: Each email or phone number revealed spends Lusha credits, up to the key's credit limit.

capabilities.label: Look up companies
capabilities.description: Find one company by domain, name or Lusha id: size, revenue, industry, location and description, and optionally signals such as hiring surges, headcount changes and news.

revoke: In Lusha, open API & connectors, then Manage API Keys, and delete the key. Agents lose access to Lusha at once.

tools.name: lusha_find_contact
tools.description: Find one person in Lusha. Send email, or linkedin_url, or person_id, or first_name and last_name with company_name or company_domain. Spends credits for the emails and phone numbers revealed.

company_name.name: companyName
company_name.description: The company the person works at

company_domain.name: companyDomain
company_domain.description: The domain of the company the person works at, such as acme.com

tools.name: lusha_find_company
tools.description: Find one company in Lusha by domain, name or Lusha id: size, revenue, industry, locations and description. Spends credits.

domain.description: The company's domain, such as acme.com

signals.description: Also return recent signals of these kinds

signals_start_date.name: signalsStartDate
signals_start_date.description: Signals since this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default six months ago)
